verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI runs on CPU ('No GPU required', a CI-tested CPU path) and auto-detects GPUs, but nothing mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or CPU instruction-set detection or optimization. General CPU support is an adjacent capability and does not show that LocalAI uses these instruction sets for faster inference.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
